description: Vellum Assistant on the text-only GLM 5.2 (served by Fireworks), with the image-fallback plugin in handle-only mode: an image the agent reads is replaced by a marker naming the file, with no up-front vision call, so image_ask is the only route to the pixels. The handle-only half of the caption-versus-handle-only comparison on detailed image extraction. Identical to vellum-glm-text-only-caption apart from imageFallback.captionMode, so a difference between the two is the mode.
setup: assistant inference providers connections create fireworks-personal --provider fireworks --auth api_key --credential credential/fireworks/api_key
